svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Group A, Division 2, Low Occupant Load

g.text: where the building is sprinklered throughout)
of Division A: 3 storeys or less, building
area not more than 600 m² (6 458 ft²)

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
This Part may apply to a Group A, Division 2
assembly occupancy that is permitted by Article
3.1.2.7. to be classified as a Group D business and
personal services occupancy, provided the building
in which it is located complies with Sentence
1.3.3.3.(1) of Division A
See Note A-3.1.2.7.
Article 3.1.2.7.
A suite of Group A, Division 2 assembly occupancy,
except a child or infant daycare facility, is permitted
to be classified as Group D provided (a) the number of
persons in the suite does not exceed 30, and (b) the
suite is separated from the remainder of the building by
a fire separation having a fire-resistance rating of not
less than 1 h. That fire separation need not have a
fire-resistance rating where the building is sprinklered
throughout. A permanent sign, with lettering not less
than 50 mm (1 15/16″) high with a 12 mm (½″) stroke,
indicating the lesser of the occupant load for the suite
or 30 persons, is posted in a conspicuous location near
the principal entrance of the suite.
Sentence 1.3.3.3.(1) of Division A
Part 9 applies to buildings of 3 storeys or less in
building height, having a building area not exceeding
600 m² (6 458 ft²), used for Group C, Group D, Group E,
or Group F, Division 2 or 3 major occupancies.
Drawn: one storey, walls cut low, storey above dashed. Sign wording, furniture and suite size are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.2.5. (page 9-61)
